summary: Phase covering Channel Partner Portal, Overdue Auto-Nudge, and Section R edge cases tested backend + frontend. 18/19 new Section R tests pass; the 1 failure is a REAL backend RBAC bug: partner user (with only partner.portal permission) can access GET /api/v1/leads and list all leads. Full regression: 117/119 (1 known flaky test_qualify_updates_score_status, 1 partner-leads leak — the actual bug). Frontend: Partner Portal renders with all required data-testids, admin sees Channel Partners + Commissions nav, lead drawer shows dnc-btn/invalid-btn, bk-cancel/pay-fail wired in deals.js.

critical.issue: Missing permission:leads.view middleware. Channel Partner (partner.portal only) returns 200 and full lead list. Review requirement explicitly says 'A partner must NOT be able to access GET /api/v1/leads (expect 403)'. Also affects leads/{id}/show, leads/board, leads/call-list, leads/check-duplicate (routes/api.php lines 57–62 have no permission middleware).

action_items: Add ->middleware('permission:leads.view') to routes/api.php lines 57–62 (leads index, board, call-list, check-duplicate, show). Ensure the 'channel_partner' role does NOT get leads.view (it currently only has partner.portal, so adding the middleware will correctly 403 partner users while sales/marketing/admin continue to have leads.view via their role perms). Verify existing seeder role→perms map includes leads.view for sales_exec / sales_manager / marketing / administrator.

OPTIONAL: The Section R WhatsApp suppression path in WhatsAppService::send still creates a WhatsappMessage row with status='failed' rather than fully skipping. Semantically correct (no outbound dispatch, activity logged as blocked) but if strict 'no row at all' is required, refactor to return early without creating the record.
critical_code_review_comments: ROUTES BUG: routes/api.php `GET leads`, `GET leads/board`, `GET leads/call-list`, `GET leads/check-duplicate`, and `GET leads/{lead}` have NO permission middleware. Any authenticated user (including channel_partner with only partner.portal) can list/read all leads. Add permission:leads.view.
BookingService::cancel force-updates commission_status='none' even if it was previously 'approved' but not paid — desired per spec but worth documenting; paid commissions correctly preserved.
RunReminders overdue block: DemandLetter is generated via demand_letter_id nullable check. Confirmed idempotent (runs once per milestone). Nudge tracked in reminders_sent array as expected.
ChannelPartnerController::portal returns partner-scoped leads/bookings correctly. Admin without linked partner correctly returns 404 (verified).
WhatsAppService::send has proper R1.3/R8.2 consent guard (do_not_contact || whatsapp_opt_out → no driver dispatch, blocked activity logged).

success_rate.backend: 94.7% (18/19 Section R; 117/119 overall — 1 real bug, 1 known flaky)

seed_data_creation: Ran `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force` twice (before Section R suite and before full regression). Section R tests create ephemeral TEST_R_/TEST_BK_/TEST_PF_/TEST_ND_ leads and use tinker to backdate milestones. One partner-attributed lead (Vikram Nair, id=1) was marked Won for commission verification.

(2) TestPartnerPortalScoping — portal OK, denies partners/commissions (leads currently FAILING = real bug), admin 404. (5) TestBookingCancel — plot released to 'available', pending milestones cancelled, cs role can cancel, exec 403. (6) TestPaymentFail — pays a milestone via /milestones/{id}/pay, bounces via /payments/{id}/fail, verifies milestone reverts from paid, exec denied (403/404). (7) TestOverdueNudge — verify+pay-token→confirmed booking, backdate a milestone due_at via tinker, run `php artisan crm:reminders`, assert reminders_sent contains 'nudge', status='overdue', DemandLetter row created. Frontend: partner_portal renders /portal with nav-portal + portal-cards + 4 portal-lead-* + 1 portal-booking-*. Admin Channel Partners page: add-partner-btn + partner-row-{id} + Edit. Commissions page: commission-row-{id} + comm-approve-/comm-pay- (hidden when status='paid' — expected). Lead drawer: dnc-btn + invalid-btn visible for unlocked/unflagged leads. bk-cancel-{id} + pay-fail-{id} wired in deals.js.
rca of the issue: GET /api/v1/leads returns 200 for channel_partner because routes/api.php declares `Route::get('leads', ...)` INSIDE the `auth:sanctum` group but without any `->middleware('permission:leads.view')` gate. The permission `leads.view` is defined in the seeder ($permissions map) but no route consumes it. Fix: chain `->middleware('permission:leads.view')` on lines 57, 58, 59, 60, 62 of routes/api.php. Repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <partner_token>' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/leads` → 200 with data payload. After fix: expect 403 for partner, 200 for admin/sales/marketing (assuming their role includes leads.view — verify DatabaseSeeder role→perms mapping includes leads.view for administrator/sales_manager/sales_exec/marketing/post_sales roles as appropriate).
